title: Working Class (TV series)
lead_cast: Melissa PetermanEd AsnerSteve KazeePatrick FabianLachlan BuchananCourtney MerrittCameron Castaneda
premise_summary: Working Class is an American television sitcom created by Jill Cargerman, which premiered on CMT on January 28, 2011. The network ordered twelve episodes for the comedy, which was the first scripted series for the network.
